content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 500/502 rates detected for service=redwood-inference-prod region=us-east-1 at 04:22 UTC. On-call notified.

Nora: I'm oncall. Noted. Quick triage questions: is this limited to a model pool / route? Any user-facing 503s reported?

Priya: Support reports three customer sessions saw repeated 502 responses beginning ~04:20. Customers A & B have live inference workloads. No billing impact reported.

Mateo: pulling dashboards now. Live metric snapshots:
- 04:16 CPU on inference-worker nodes step up
- 04:18 steady increase in request latency p95 -> 420ms
- 04:21 spike in 502s (mostly from the /chat endpoint)

Jun: running a quick log search — note our log sampling for high-traffic clusters was reduced two days ago under infra ticket LOG-212 to 10%. That may hide app-level stack traces.

Nora: still proceed — gather what we can. Mateo, query the load balancer logs to see if backend is responding or if LB is returning 502s.

Mateo: LB shows 502s with backend="inference-pool-eu" for some requests. Strange, region mismatch (us-east requests routed to eu pool for some legacy routing rules).

Priya: uh oh, we pushed a routing config at 02:30 that added fallback routing for mixed-region tenants (config INF-ccf). Could be misrouted traffic to a pool that doesn't have the new quantized model.

Jun: I'll try node syslogs for OOMs and kube events. Because of sampling we may be missing app logs, but node-level events are intact.

Jun: query command used:
```
logs.query("kubernetes.event AND message:oom OR message:OutOfMemory", { from: "-40m" })
```
Result: OOM events on nodes worker-eu-12 and worker-eu-15 at 04:19-04:20.

Nora: that suggests Model A rollout in eu caused memory pressure -> OOM -> 502s for misrouted us-east traffic. Hypothesis list: (1) routing change misrouted traffic to a node pool running a different model image with higher memory consumption; (2) autoscaler lag + memory limits too tight; (3) logging sampling hid application traces that would show model load failures.

Priya: adding hypothesis (4): a recent change to model serving flags (prefetch/kv cache) caused larger resident memory. Rollout note: deploybot shows model `gptx-lite-quant` deployed to inference-eu pool at 02:45 without updated resource requests.

Mateo: adding timeline from metrics and deploy logs:
- 02:45 deploybot: deploy gptx-lite-quant -> inference-eu pool
- 03:00 routing config INF-ccf active for mixed-region fallback
- 04:16 p95 latency increases in general
- 04:18 requests routed to inference-eu for some us-east tenants
- 04:19 node OOMs on worker-eu-12/15
- 04:21 502 spike observed in us-east dashboards

Jun: mitigation options: (A) revert routing INF-ccf to prevent cross-region fallback, (B) roll back gptx-lite-quant in eu pool to previous image, (C) bump node pool capacity temporarily and cordon problematic nodes. We should do A first to stop misrouting.

Nora: agree. Priya, can you rollback the routing config? Mateo, start scaling nodes. Jun, collect any app logs you can find around 04:17-04:21 and stash them in the incident bucket — remember sampling is low, capture what we have.

Priya: rolling back INF-ccf now -> `kubectl apply -f routing/rollback-INF-ccf.yaml`

ops-bot: routing: INF-ccf rollback executed by Priya at 04:27 UTC.

Mateo: scaling compute: added 4 nodes to inference-eu pool at 04:28. Monitoring.

Jun: collected node syslogs and kube events to /incidents/1769023178/logs. App logs are sparse but I found a few stack traces showing Failed to allocate model_shm: memory error at 04:19:11 on pods inference-gptx-2b.

Nora: good. Early customer update: Priya, please tell affected customers we are actively mitigating, suspected misrouting to an overloaded pool, ETA 20-40m.

Priya: customer updates sent.

Mateo: after routing rollback, 502s dropped from 22% -> 9% in 6 minutes. After nodes added, p95 improved and packet loss fell. 502s now ~3% as of 04:34.

Nora: marking this as mitigated for now but keeping thread open for RCA coordination. Key observability gaps to track in RCA: (1) low sampling for app logs during rollouts; (2) dashboards lacked cross-region routing visualization; (3) alerting thresholds tuned to regional baselines and missed cross-region misroutes.

Jun: note to RCA: we couldn't fully reconstruct per-request model load sequence because trace samples were dropped. Recommend increasing short-term sampling during rollouts and adding a sampling guardrail to keep 100% traces for ~10m post-deploy for model-serving pods.

Priya: also adding follow-up: routing config needs an explicit deny for cross-region fallback for latency-sensitive tenants; create INF-ccf-postmortem ticket.

Mateo: saved key logs snippet (syslog):
```
Apr 15 04:19:11 worker-eu-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 45678 (inference-worker) score 1265
Apr 15 04:19:11 worker-eu-12 kernel: Killed process 45678 (inference-worker) total-vm:15000000kB, anon-rss:13200000kB
```
Nora: assembling timeline and hypotheses into the incident runbook. Action items assigned: Jun -> collect more traces and attach to runbook, Priya -> INF-ccf-postmortem ticket and routing rollback review, Mateo -> capacity autoscaling playbook update, Ops -> implement sampling guardrails.

Priya: I'll stay for the RCA meeting in 45 minutes. Nora, handing off to you for any final notes.

Nora: thanks team. Leaving channel but monitoring DMs. Incident status changed to mitigated by incident-bot. Pinning runbook /runbooks/inference-routing-oom.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated.
